title: Consolidated-org billing: reserved capacity + burst reconciliation and pro-rata credit policy
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Background: Large customers often consolidate multiple business units under a single payer organization while purchasing a mix of reserved capacity (Committed Slots) and pay-as-you-go usage. We observed multiple edge cases where mid-cycle changes (org merges, capacity re-assignments, or security-questionnaire triggered contract holds) cause overage calculations and credits to be misapplied. This ticket defines an operational policy, automated reconciliation logic, and a playbook for automated pro-rated credits plus manual exceptions for security-gated accounts.
goals: Define deterministic pro-rata credit rules when reserved capacity is reassigned between sub-orgs mid-cycle
Automate burst-overage reconciliation that respects reserved capacity reservations and does not double-charge during transient reassignment windows
Integrate a hold-and-review flow driven by enterprise security questionnaire flags that can pause invoice finalization without blocking metering data capture
Pilot the policy as a pricing/packaging experiment for 10 consolidated-org customers and measure invoice dispute rates and NPS impact
out_of_scope: Changes to core metering collection (no agent changes)
Full redesign of pricing tiers — this is a reconciliation/playbook layer only
Support for legacy invoices prior to 2025-01-01
acceptance_criteria: Automated reconciliation engine produces a corrected invoice preview for consolidated-orgs with mixed reserved/payg within 24 hours of the cycle close
Pro-rata credit calculation verified against 10 synthetic scenarios (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/pricing/PR-842) with 0% mismatch to agreed formula
Invoice finalization can be paused by security_questionnaire flag without losing metering granularity; paused invoices appear in a 'pending-security-review' state in Console
Pilot customers see a >=30% reduction in manual credit disputes vs baseline for eligible scenarios
Operational runbook created and reviewed by Billing, Support, and Legal teams
implementation_notes: Add reconciliation layer in billing pipeline: post-metering, pre-invoice computation. Layer takes inputs: per-suborg reserved assignments, consume windows, and transient reassignments
Key formula: pro-rata credit = reserved_rate * overlap_fraction - billed_overage_adjustment (documented in Confluence)
When reassignment window < 6 hours, apply transient-grace policy to avoid churn; need product decision on grace thresholds
Expose preview endpoint for customer-facing invoice preview: /billing/v1/preview?org=CONSOLIDATED_ID
Flag security-questionnaire holds via org-level tag; Console shows hold reason and link to support ticket
Telemetry: emit reconciliation_reason and credit_delta as tags to billing-dashboards (grafana/redwood-billing)
risks: Complexity of reserved assignment lineage could cause incorrect credits if historical assignment data is incomplete
Pausing invoice finalization could delay revenue recognition; coordinate with finance for accruals
Edge-case churn if multiple rapid reassignments occur in a single cycle — potential oscillation of credits
Security-questionnaire hold might be abused to delay payment; need guardrails and SLA on manual reviews
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal simulation): run reconciliation logic on last 6 months of consolidated-org invoices in staging and validate against manual calculations (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (pilot): enable for 10 invited consolidated-org customers; provide billing-preview and support queue for 1 cycle (1 month)
Phase 3 (expand): open to all consolidated-orgs and surface policy in Console with self-serve admin controls (2 weeks)
Phase 4 (GA): enable default and measure KPIs; fallback to legacy flow via admin toggle
test_plan: Unit tests for pro-rata formula matrix (covering multi-day reassignments, partial-hour windows)
Integration tests: end-to-end from metering -> reconciliation -> invoice preview
Chaos test: simulate rapid reassignments and ensure grace threshold prevents oscillation
Manual QA with finance: validate settlement CSVs and revenue-impact reports
communication: Pilot invite template and FAQ for customers stored in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/pilot-billing-reconciliation
